value.rationale: For a newly introduced graph-domination parameter, a natural full infinite family of directed biased cycles is solved at every fidelity/threshold, including exact minima, every optimizer, and a complete labelled feasibility polynomial. Beyond routine gambler's-ruin algebra, the first drift-improvable gap is shown to be four, with a unique algebraic optimal strength up to reversal and an explicit 25 percent reduction in asymptotic required sources at a rational threshold. The phenomenon shows that uniform coverage need not be optimized by symmetric transitions, a substantive boundary relevant to source-placement design.
